name: The Return
controllingIdea: Sometimes life brings us full circle, and home means returning to where we truly belong.

narrativeArc.incitingIncident: Client needs to move back - family, career, retirement, or drawn by roots
narrativeArc.risingAction: Nostalgia meets reality of a changed market and neighborhood
narrativeArc.crisis: Can they afford or find home in the place they love? Is it the same?
narrativeArc.climax: Discovery of the right home for this new chapter
narrativeArc.resolution: Welcomed back, new roots in familiar soil, circle complete

triggerMoments.moment: Empty nesters downsizing to old neighborhood

questions.question: Why is your client returning to this area?
questions.purpose: Establish the motivation and emotional core
questions.placeholder: Her parents are getting older and she wants to be closer...

questions.question: What memories or connections do they have with this place?
questions.placeholder: She grew up here, went to the local high school, met her husband here...

questions.question: What surprised them about searching for a home here now?
questions.placeholder: Prices have tripled since she left, the old neighborhood is so different...

questions.question: What made this particular home the right one for their return?
questions.placeholder: It's two blocks from her childhood home and has a guest suite for her parents...

questions.question: How does it feel to be home again?
questions.placeholder: She says her kids will grow up knowing their grandparents, just like she did...

promptConfig.systemContext: This is a homecoming story. Someone is returning to a place that holds meaning. Focus on the emotional journey and the sense of belonging that comes from coming full circle.
promptConfig.toneGuidance: Warm, nostalgic, but grounded in present reality. This isn't just about the past - it's about a new chapter in a meaningful place.

usageHints: Great for clients moving back for family reasons
Focus on the 'why' - the deeper meaning of the return
Speaks to others considering similar moves

exampleScenarios.title: Back to Care for Parents
exampleScenarios.situation: Woman returns after 20 years to be near aging parents
exampleScenarios.sampleInput: She left for college 20 years ago and built a career in Chicago. Now her parents need help and she realized she missed Sunday dinners more than city life. Found a place with an in-law suite.

expectedOutput.hook: She left 20 years ago. She came back for Sunday dinners.
expectedOutput.keyMoment: Some things are worth more than a corner office.
